Now write the following. Return only the requested text.
Write a monthly engineering update for a team of twelve, covering a migration, two hires, and a slipped deadline. Around 200 words.

**August Engineering Update**

We completed the database migration ahead of schedule. The team coordinated across three service layers to move 2.8M records without downtime. Performance improved 15% on read-heavy workloads, and we retired two legacy query paths that had been bottlenecking search.

We brought two engineers on board. Sarah Chen joins as a senior backend engineer and will lead the API layer refactor. Marcus Rodriguez starts in platform infrastructure and will own our deployment pipeline and container orchestration.

The user export feature slipped two weeks. We discovered schema inconsistencies in historical data that required backfilling before we could proceed safely. We're resuming work this week with revised scope—we'll ship JSON export first and defer CSV support to October.

The team closed 47 issues and merged 156 pull requests. Test coverage on new code reached 76%. We resolved three production incidents, each traced to missing validation at service boundaries. We've now deployed input validators across all API endpoints.

Next month: onboard Sarah and Marcus fully, ship the user export feature, and begin the caching layer design phase.

**August Engineering Update**

We shipped the database migration. Moved 2.8M records across three services with zero downtime. Read performance jumped 15%, and we ditched two legacy query paths that were slowing search.

Two new engineers joined: Sarah Chen (senior backend, leading the API refactor) and Marcus Rodriguez (infrastructure, taking over deployments and container orchestration).

The user export feature slipped two weeks. We hit schema inconsistencies in old data that needed backfilling first. We're shipping JSON export this week, pushing CSV to October.

Stats: 47 issues closed, 156 PRs merged, 76% test coverage on new code. Three production incidents, all from missing validation at service boundaries. We've deployed input validators across all endpoints now.

Next: onboard Sarah and Marcus, land user export, start the caching layer.
